# Stokan Video (international)

- Video editing: corporate, training, events, product videos.
- Motion graphics: animated infographics, charts, kinetic typography, brand animation.
- Reels & Shorts: vertical 9:16 for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube.
- Live streaming: multicamera streams for events, sports and conferences.
